name: veris-e2b-workspace
description: Veris interception for E2B: the SDK, and the OpenCode plugin built on it.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @veris-ai/e2b && npm run build -w @veris-ai/e2b-opencode
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @veris-ai/e2b && npm run typecheck -w @veris-ai/e2b-opencode
scripts.test: npm run test -w @veris-ai/e2b && npm run test -w @veris-ai/e2b-opencode
